description:
Proving he can score in a multitude of ways, Stars forward Jason Robertson used some nifty hand-eye coordination to get Dallas on the board in Game 4 of the Western Conference Final vs. Vegas at American Airlines Center on May 25, 2023. After Golden Knights goaltender Adin Hill made the initial stop on Robertson, the puck popped out of his glove, allowing Robertson to tap it to his forehand in mid-air. It was his first of two goals in the contest - both game-tying markers - in a game the Stars won 3-2 in overtime.

description:
In a game on Nov. 7, 2007, against the San Jose Sharks, Mike Modano etched his name in the history books. Needing one point to tie Phil Housley and two points to overtake him for the most by an American-born player in NHL history, Modano immediately went to work. At the 2:19 mark of the first period, Modano received a cross-ice pass from defenseman Sergei Zubov. Skating down the wing with his jersey flapping in the wind, Modano unleashed a powerful shot near the top of the circle that beat Sharks goaltender Evgeni Nabokov glove side to give the Stars an early lead and place him in a tie with Housley. Modano scored again before the five-minute mark to surpass Housley as the highest-scoring U.S.-born player in League history.

description:
With the Stars holding a 3-2 lead in the closing seconds of Game 4 in their first-round series against Minnesota at Xcel Energy Center on April 23, 2023, goaltender Jake Oettinger delivered a highlight-reel save on Wild forward Marcus Johansson. Oettinger was able to push from right to left to rob Johansson, who was all alone at the right faceoff circle. Oettinger's glove save preserved the lead for Dallas, who won the game to tie the series at 2-2.
